description: Words stripped from a tag slug to find the tag whose image it shares. A prefix is stripped only from the start ('classic-rock' -> 'rock'), a suffix only from the end ('acoustic-music' -> 'acoustic'); stripping repeats, and only applies when the remainder is itself a known tag. The stripped tag still displays verbatim in the app - this only decides which image it shows. Keep this to words that qualify era/generality/format without changing what the genre IS: 'death' in 'death-metal' or 'german' in 'german-folk' name a distinct genre and do not belong here. Order matters: earlier entries are tried first.
